Tokenizer line and column tracking broken after recent changes

#### Description

The tokenizer is no longer correctly tracking line and column positions for tokens. Line numbers and column positions are being reported incorrectly, which breaks functionality that depends on accurate token positioning.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from sqlglot.tokens import Tokenizer

# Test basic line/column tracking
tokens = Tokenizer().tokenize("SELECT /*\nline break\n*/\n'x\n y',\nx")
print(f"Token 0 line: {tokens[0].line}, col: {tokens[0].col}")  # Expected: line=1, col=6
print(f"Token 1 line: {tokens[1].line}, col: {tokens[1].col}")  # Expected: line=5, col=3

# Test with CRLF line breaks
tokens = Tokenizer().tokenize('SELECT\r\n  1,\r\n  2')
print(f"Token 0 line: {tokens[0].line}")  # Expected: line=1
print(f"Token 1 line: {tokens[1].line}")  # Expected: line=2
print(f"Token 3 line: {tokens[3].line}")  # Expected: line=3
```

The line and column numbers are not being updated correctly during tokenization, causing incorrect position information to be returned.
</issue>
